references.text: Joshua 17:2 mentions Abiezer (Iezer) as one of the descendants of Gilead and confirms the lineage from the tribe of Manasseh
Helek is mentioned as one of the ancestors of Zelophehad's daughters, who were descendants of Gilead, son of Machir
Gideon was from the clan of Abiezer, which descends from the Gilead mentioned here
Abiezer is mentioned as a clan from the tribe of Manasseh in connection with the story of Gideon
The genealogy of Manasseh's descendants includes Gilead and his sons, which corresponds to the clans mentioned here
